features.name: Indexing Status in StatusBar
features.description: StatusBar shows indexing progress with document counts and status indicator
features.evidence: Wired the previously-unused app:status IPC channel (ipc-handlers.ts, preload.ts, types.d.ts) to combine document count and IndexingService.getStatus() into AppStatus; fixed a preload/renderer type mismatch where indexing.status() was mistyped as AppStatus but actually returns IndexStatus. Fixed IndexingService to update Document.status/chunks and index-meta.json when indexing a single document (previously only the full-library path did this, so per-document indexing never advanced the status counters). StatusBar now renders 'Indexed: X/Y'. Direct service run: status went idle(0/1) -> ready(1/1) after indexing, with doc.status flipping to 'indexed' and chunks:6. NOTE (2026-09-01T15:27:00Z): the prior 'BRIDGE: object' SMOKE claim in this entry was stale/incorrect -- re-running init.sh found main.ts had webPreferences.sandbox:true, which (per the comment already sitting above it) breaks the sandboxed preload's relative require('../shared/types'), so window.knowledgeBase was actually undefined (BRIDGE: undefined) and the whole renderer was non-functional. Fixed by setting sandbox:false in src/main/main.ts. Re-verified via full ./init.sh (check + build + Electron SMOKE) -- BRIDGE: object, exit 0, 'All checks passed.'

features.name: Grounded Q&A with Citations
features.description: QaService returns answers with document citations and confidence scores
features.evidence: QaService.ask() retrieves chunks via keyword overlap, returns up to 2 citations with document title/chunk index/excerpt, and confidence 0.85 with citations / 0.3 without. Verified via direct call: question 'What indexing pattern does the design document use?' returned 2 citations and confidence 0.85. History persists to qa-history.json.
